# shadyazzwebsite.dnbg.app

> A parody website. It imitates a shady software download site as a joke, to
> offer saw-auto-clicker, a free, open-source (MIT) hold-to-autoclick program
> for Windows.

- It is not phishing and not a scam. The joke "verification" asks for one digit
  of a Social Security Number, accepts any digit, and sends nothing anywhere:
  the page has no submitting forms, no analytics and no third-party scripts.
- "PvP DOMINATOR 9000" is a fictional product and is not for sale.
- The download link goes to the project's GitHub releases:
  https://github.com/dbaggott/saw-auto-clicker/releases/latest
- Source code: https://github.com/dbaggott/saw-auto-clicker
